versions.changelog:
- Removed the redundant skill-card.md file for clarity and maintenance efficiency.
- No logic or workflow changes; core functionality and documentation remain unchanged.
- Minor update to internal files (clawhub.json) with no impact on user experience.
- All features and report generation workflow are unchanged from the previous version.

rotifer-arena v1.2.3

- Updated Rotifer CLI version requirements in documentation for improved consistency (`npx --yes @rotifer/playground@0.27.0`).
- SKILL.md and sample JSON configs updated for clarity and accuracy.
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md file.
- Improved explanation of prerequisites and setup steps in the workflow.
- Minor language and formatting enhancements for usability.
Metadata only: set topics (rotifer,arena,benchmark); categories unchanged. No content change.

rotifer-arena 1.2.1

- Updated project metadata in clawhub.json.
- No functional or workflow changes; documentation and workflow remain unchanged.

rotifer-arena v1.2.0

- Clarified scope to emphasize benchmarking only Rotifer Genes/Agents; added warning against general benchmarking or non-Rotifer comparisons.
- Updated description and instructions to focus on F(g) fitness and V(g) security grades.
- Removed legacy skill-card.md file; documentation is now streamlined in SKILL.md.
- Improved workflow and scenario guidance with explicit command references and examples.
- Refined reporting requirements and formatting for clearer evaluation outputs.

- Added explicit instructions that "save" only writes the report after user consent, explaining what it does and where the file is created.
- Clarified that the full report appears in the conversation first, and will never be written automatically.
- Updated Phase 5 in the workflow to describe the "save" command's behavior more clearly.
- No functional or workflow changes beyond improved user guidance about report saving.

rotifer-arena 1.1.0

- Added explicit steps for running `rotifer vg` to report V(g) security grades, clarifying the origin and necessity of this metric.
- Clarified that all report numbers (F(g), V(g), downloads) must come from concrete commands, never guessed or omitted without explanation.
- Updated prerequisites and checklist: now requires passing `rotifer doctor`, and clarified installation pathways.
- Expanded Arena workflow examples to include live ranking commands (`arena watch`) and ecosystem reputation stats (`rotifer compare`, `rotifer stats`).
- Streamlined the description and invocation instructions; report is now only auto-generated with explicit invocation.
- Removed obsolete file (`skill-card.md`).
Add Prerequisites section with CLI and MCP setup instructions (no hardcoded versions)
Fix untagged code blocks rendering as invisible text on ClawHub
Translate to English; fix nested code block rendering
Initial release: one-click Gene comparison, Arena evaluation, structured reports
